items.item: USES.md body rebuilt around what a reader can do (Fable §1.1, astra's first point)

The 'Not claimed' columns are gone, and with them '**Nothing claimed**' in bold and the two 'that is not a finding that ...' tails (re-said as 'so whether either is new / whether a tradition holds these results is not settled there'). 'What each field already has, and what the account adds' (08's credits, verbatim from the third pass) is its own section after the fields (explicit id what-each-field-already-has), so the ten-minute part is the first paragraph, In brief, the line on the labels and the reader's field: 7 to 9 minutes for the longest, against 10 to 13 before. Repeats said once: the novelty verdict only in that section's opening (dropped from the sciences Reading line); 'actual systems meet the premises' once, in In brief, with the use-today/law-holds distinction moved there from the closing; the ranking disclaimer once, in In brief (dropped from the exits' lead). Every link to a home is kept (link sets diffed: only 02 #capture became #r-closed-capture per D1, and the internal #the-full-table link went with the glance table); new links: the meta-attractor folder, GOALS #generative-alignment, 02 #r-capture-through-the-rule, #r-shaping-selected-among-groups, 08 #one-relational-unfolding, 05 §7 for the drain. Every failure stays as it fell (T1's eight whole tests, T2's former wording, LA2 against T7's case, small frozen runs whose predictions failed, MQ1's 80 of 151, CMT not run). Every old anchor kept: the-full-table, exits-and-design-laws-at-their-standing, what-this-page-does-not-do as explicit ids; field-by-field, exits-and-design-laws, worked-examples, what-this-page-does by unchanged headings. items.item: D1, the meta-attractor, in the opening paragraph and the examples' checklist
items.how: USES.md first paragraph: 'how it comes to lock on what it already chose, and how winning comes to buy power over the rule that selects: the loop the work calls the [meta-attractor](../meta-attractor/README.md), proved to lock, on stated models, where the rule and how it is read are both formed from the share it selects ([02 §9](chapters/02-MAP.md#r-closed-capture))' (the coordinator's short form). The People and AI section's Proved line adds the second order with its home: the capacity to shape the rule selected by what comes back to the shapers, alone or through their groups, net of its cost (02 §9 #r-shaping-selected-among-groups). USES-EXAMPLES' AJ checklist: the plan's 'failure of the first two together' is now introduced as 'The meta-attractor, the loop in which winning comes to buy power over the rule that selects', followed by its closed form as 02 §9 proves it, linking the folder and #r-closed-capture. GENERATIVE-REGIMES' working definition is not presented. Mirrored in both Chinese pages.

USES.md first paragraph: 'From this map we want to design an alignment of the joint selection, people, institutions and trained systems selecting together, that falls into neither instrumental convergence nor the meta-attractor: where shaping its rule is selected, the rule still reads what lies beyond the shapers' share, so that a loss there can turn it ([the goal](../../GOALS.md#generative-alignment))'. The People and AI do-line: '... so that, where shaping it is selected, it still reads beyond the shapers' share and a loss there can turn it'. 'does not (come to) select for control over its own selection / itself' is gone from all four pages (a test now holds that). USES-EXAMPLES' checklist says condition 1 with GOALS' gloss, linked. Chinese as README-ZH now says it.

items.item: D3 and D4, evaluation within becoming; no should beyond becoming
items.how: In brief: 'There is no should beyond becoming ([the opening](OPENING.md)): whether a loss counts, and which course is better, form within it too, in what people and AI come to read ([07 §1](chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#evaluation)), and the laws, drawn on the dynamics alone, do not settle it.' Then the ranking sentence as 07 T8 says it (C or another named order; the continuation condition fixing whose losses count, ranking nothing; each a hypothesis where used, 07 §4). That everything, standards included, forms within one relational unfolding is said once, as argued, in the line on the labels (the page's how-far place), linking 08 #one-relational-unfolding. No 'not in the laws but in a reading' anywhere (test holds it).

Once, at the end of 'What this page does': 'Made with AI: the page was written from its homes and checked against them by AI readers on 8 and 9 November 2026, and its readings are AI's unless their home says otherwise; the person who directs the work has read its important parts, and no independent human review is recorded yet.' 'no person's review ... recorded' 3 times before, 0 now; the top provenance is in the HTML comment only. Visible 'AI' 45 before, 29 now (most are 'people and AI', 'AI systems'); 'AI reading' 15 before, 5 now, kept only where a home's label carries a D-number or 'new' (D26, D45 twice, 生生's [AI reading]) and in 'every class and reading AI's' for 06, a reader's fact about the classical readings. Chinese: '本页借助 AI 写成……主持这项工作的人读过其中重要的部分，尚无独立的人工审查记录。' once at the end; the top translation label shortened to '本页由 AI 译自英文版；义以英文版为准。'
